column1: # manifests/skills.tsv — the global skill store, one row per source repository.
#   source  A spec `skills add` accepts: owner/repo, or owner/repo/path/to/skill.
#   skills  Comma-separated skill names, or * to follow a source collection.
#   mode    select — install the named skills.
#           whole  — install every skill the source exposes, including new ones
#                    on --update. Source paths can limit discovery to a subfolder.
# Additional installed skills are preserved unless --prune-skills is requested.
# Skill names are the `name:` in each SKILL.md, which is what `--skill` matches.
# They are not always the repo's directory name (react-best-practices installs as
# vercel-react-best-practices), so take them from `skills add <source> -l`.
